S0868.L3t: To achieve a 90% confidence interval with width at most 0.08, the margin of error must be 0.04, and using the conservative proportion of 0.5 gives a required sample size of about 423.
S0868.L3f: If you mistakenly use a margin of error of 0.08 instead of half the width, the required sample size drops to about 106, and further using a proportion of 0.1 instead of 0.5 reduces it to about 27.
